name: Eris Outis
source:
In Eris' mind, life is one big fairy tale — and she's the main star! She claims to be the ideal storybook hero, but she's more akin to a small town girl with big city dreams. Needless to say, she's always on the hunt for her next big adventure.

Eris wants nothing more than to be revered and loved all over the world — whatever this is out of pure altruism or egoism remains to be seen. That said, while she loves humanity as a whole, Eris struggles to understand people individually. This ends to drive a wedge in her goals, but she's not giving up!

She enjoys chaos and mayhem a little too much for her own good ..
